_comment: Single source of truth for the app list. LAUNCH DAY: set an app's status to 'live' and fill app_store_url + release_date, then run tools/sync.py — every badge, press-kit row and the About line update themselves. Apps can go live independently.

apps.name: Feastmark
apps.tagline: Turn recipe videos into your personal cookbook.

support.intro: iPhone, iOS 18 or later. No account, no ads, no trackers — your recipes live on the device.

faqs.q: What can I save recipes from?
faqs.a: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and recipe blogs. When a post’s caption has no recipe in it, Feastmark falls back to the spoken audio in the video. Some of the largest recipe sites sit behind bot protection that blocks the import — if a link will not come through, that is usually why.

faqs.q: A link didn’t come through — now what?
faqs.a: Save it as a draft and finish it by hand: every field is editable, and you can write a recipe from scratch. One thing that will not work is a page holding a whole collection of recipes — save the individual recipe’s page instead.
Your library, Cook Mode and the cook log all work with no connection. Importing a new recipe needs the network, because the link has to be fetched and read.

faqs.q: How do I get my recipes onto another device?
faqs.a: You can’t yet. There is no account and no sync — recipes live on the iPhone that saved them. Worth knowing before you build up a big library.

showcase.blurb: Turn recipe videos into your personal cookbook. One tap from Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube — even when the recipe is only spoken in the video.

press.price: Free — no ads, no account, nothing in the app is paywalled at launch
press.privacy_note: No account required. Recipes stay on the device. No data sold, ever.

apps.name: PayoffPilot
apps.tagline: Pay off debt. Pay once. Done.

support.intro: iPhone. No account, no bank linking — every figure stays on the device.

faqs.q: Snowball or Avalanche — which should I pick?
faqs.a: Snowball clears your smallest balances first, so the wins come quickly. Avalanche targets the highest interest rate first and costs less overall. The Compare tab runs both against your real numbers side by side.

faqs.q: How do I log a payment?
faqs.a: Swipe left on any debt in the Debts tab and tap Log Payment, or open the debt and tap Log Payment there. The new balance is worked out for you.
A reminder needs a due date on the debt, and notifications turned on in iPhone Settings › PayoffPilot › Notifications. A due date already in the past will not schedule one.

more.label: Full PayoffPilot support guide — adding debts, scenarios, PDF export →

showcase.blurb: Plan your way out of debt. Compare Snowball and Avalanche with your real numbers, simulate what-ifs, and track every payment to debt-free — all private, all on your phone.

press.price: Free; PayoffPilot Pro is a one-time purchase, launch price $6.99 — no subscription
press.privacy_note: No account, no bank linking, no data collection — everything stays on the device.

support.intro: An iMessage sticker pack — 30 stickers, $0.99 one time. It has no network access at all.

faqs.q: How do I use the stickers?
faqs.a: Open any conversation in Messages, open the sticker drawer, and pick ReelTalk. The app also includes a gallery, so you can browse the whole pack in one place.
No. No account, no tracking, and no network access — it is a sticker pack, it could not phone home if it tried.

showcase.blurb: Fishing pun stickers for iMessage. Thirty hand-made originals starring a bass with sunglasses — big bass energy for your group chats, $0.99 one time.

press.privacy_note: No network access, no accounts, no tracking — everything runs on the device.

support.intro: In TestFlight beta right now. iPhone, iOS 18 or later.

faqs.q: How do I join the beta?
faqs.a: Signups are handled on gunmark.app. You will need an iPhone on iOS 18 or later and Apple’s TestFlight app.
On the device, and only there. Gunmark makes zero network calls — there is no account to create and no server holding your photos or paperwork.

showcase.blurb: Your armory, documented. Every gun, every angle, every mod, every receipt and tax stamp — on your device, nowhere else. Beta signups open now.

press.price: Free for your first 3 firearms with every feature; Gunmark Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription
press.privacy_note: No accounts, no servers, no tracking. The app makes zero network calls — collection, photos, and documents never leave the device.
